title: fix(record-page): authored feed panels show the record's field history and offer Field Changes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg48yiCyRmnqoUoHcQ9VbBp6)_
Fixes #33996

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:对象开了字段历史(`trackHistory`)时,作者自定义的记录页上,讨论/动态面板(`record:discussion`、`record:chatter`、`record:activity`)现在也显示「谁把哪个字段从多少改成多少」,筛选里出现「仅字段变更」;作者写的默认筛选 `changes_only` 不再被悄悄当成「全部」。
- **为什么改**:按裁决 6996126030「A 补实现」:以前只有平台自动生成的默认页读字段历史,作者一自定义记录页,这份信息在页上任何地方都看不到。
- **风险与回滚**:只改界面,不改协议。这类页面在面板出现在屏幕上时多一次审计读取(最近 50 条)和一次用户名查询;没有面板在屏、或对象没开历史时不多读。已有自定义页的面板在「全部」里会多出带前后值的变更行。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `historyConsumerOnScreen`(何时发审计读取);② `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordTimelineStream.ts` 的 `mergeFieldHistoryIntoFeed`(合并与配对);③ `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-chatter.tsx`(默认页上不重复合并)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx`,预期 21 个用例全绿,其中「an assigned page of a trackHistory object reads the audit log while its feed panel is on screen」通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The read** (`RecordDetailView.tsx`): on an assigned (authored) page the `sys_audit_log` read and its `sys_user` name lookup go out exactly when the page's feed is on screen (`feedConsumerOnScreen`: a `record:discussion` / `record:chatter` / `record:activity` in the tree this view renders, judged with the `?tab=` the strip writes), latched for the view's life as before, and only on a `trackHistory` object. The synthesized page keeps its own rule unchanged. `RecordFieldChangesContext` now carries the field changes on an assigned page too; `RecordFieldHistoryContext` keeps its one rule (`historyEnabled && historyEntries !== null`), so a reader whose audit read is refused is still offered no Field Changes (#30344).
- **The merge** (`recordTimelineStream.ts`): `mergeFieldHistoryIntoFeed` is the stream's pairing (#30122, shared with `mergeTimelineStream` through one `pairedStream`), oldest first as a panel reads. No field changes returns the feed array itself, so a page without history draws exactly what it drew.
- **The panels**: `record:activity`'s panel face and `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` merge the field changes in; on the default record page the chatter leaves them to the stream (`useDefaultRecordPage`). `unifiedTimeline: false` un-mixes them and the panel then offers no `changes_only` (a filter over nothing). The panel face draws a paired activity row's before and after values (`RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`), as the stream's row does.
- **Checklist**: `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` knownGaps[3] re-read (revision 16): the `changes_only` leg is blocked only by the missing stock carrier now. acceptance[7] is NOT flipped to driven: no stock showcase `record:discussion` panel sits on a `trackHistory` object (`showcase_project` has none), so the fixture still does not open on stock.

## Tests

Run at head `a7152744`.

- New pins (`recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`, a top-level describe): the pure merge (order, pairing, identity when empty); for both `record:activity` and `record:discussion`: All holds the paired diff once and the unpaired change; an authored `changes_only` opens on Field Changes and holds only the field history; CONTROL no history shown (refused / no trackHistory) offers no Field Changes and the value reads as All; `unifiedTimeline: false` shows no change and offers no Field Changes; CONTROL the discussion panel on the default page leaves the changes to the stream.
- App-shell (`RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx`): the flipped pin and three controls (no feed panel on the open tab: no read until the tab opens; no feed panel at all: never; no `trackHistory`: never), plus an authored `record:discussion` with `filterMode: 'changes_only'` driven through the real view.
- Reverse pins flipped: "an assigned page of a trackHistory object never reads the audit log" (app-shell open waves) and the title half "ignores the field changes" of the stream file's off-default-page CONTROL. "same object without it → 0 audit reads" (`recordPageTiers-26678`) is the no-trackHistory control and stays.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- `vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` (whole package): Test Files 386 passed, 1 skipped (387); Tests 3492 passed, 18 skipped (3510); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView` (95 files, narrowed): Test Files 95 passed (95); Tests 723 passed (723); VERDICT command-exit 0. The rest of `@object-ui/app-shell`'s suite is declared to CI (`Test UI`).
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation 1, the read gate (`? historyEnabled && feedConsumerOnScreen` to `? false && feedConsumerOnScreen`, landed by `ablation-replace.mjs`, blob b372cbac to 858c046f, restored to HEAD's blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): open-waves file 3 failed, 18 passed; red exactly the flipped pin, the tab-opens control and the authored `changes_only` case; the three never-read controls stayed green.
- Ablation 2, the panel merge in `record-activity.tsx` (`mergeFieldHistoryIntoFeed(sourceItems, fieldChanges)` to `sourceItems`, blob 299caa93 to b99f09ce, restored): stream file 3 failed, 49 passed; red exactly the `record:activity` legs; the `record:discussion` legs (a separate path) stayed green.
- No build or dist step: both suites resolve `@object-ui/plugin-detail` to `src` through `ui/vitest.config.mts`.

</details>

## Measurements (the ruling's two "not measured")

- **Request count on an authored page** (the open-waves harness, HotCRM's tabbed opportunity page shape, a `trackHistory` object, opened on its Activity tab). Before, taken from ablation 1's wave table: 1 request in 1 wave (the page payload POST, which carries the discussion and 200 activity rows). After, asserted by the flipped pin: 3 requests in 2 waves, the payload plus `GET sys_audit_log top=50` in wave 1 and the `sys_user` name lookup in wave 2 (plus one label read per lookup object when a change touched a lookup field, as on the default page). Opened on a tab without a feed panel: no extra read until that tab opens. No feed panel on the page, or no `trackHistory`: 0 extra reads. Latency against a live server: NOT MEASURED.
- **What existing authored panels show differently.** In this repo the one authored feed panel is the showcase's Project Detail `record:discussion` on `showcase_project`, which has no `trackHistory`: no visible change and no extra read. `app-crm` has no authored record page with a feed panel. hotcrm, read through GitHub code search (no checkout in this container): `record:activity` / `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` appear only in `src/sales/pages/home.page.ts` and `test/metadata-references.test.ts`, so no authored record page there places a feed panel: no change found. On a page that does (a `trackHistory` object), All gains the audit rows with before and after values, an update that wrote both an activity row and an audit entry is one row with its diff, an `updated` activity row with no audit entry steps aside (the stream's rule), and the filter gains Field Changes.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:platform-checklist` (run locally because the derived list names it; it is off per-PR CI) reports one problem on an item this diff does not touch: `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix` VARIANTS STALE ("SeedMode ... now has 0 members ... authored against 5"). It follows the seed-mode retirement already on main; records-forms reports clean.
- A page whose only on-screen feed block is authored `unifiedTimeline: false` still pays the read while it shows nothing from it; the gate judges node types, not props. Noted, not filed.
- The 50-entry audit window is the default page's: an `updated` activity row older than the newest 50 audit entries steps aside on an authored panel as it does on the stream.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (diff-narrowed): 46 families derived, 46 run locally; 45 exit 0, `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 1 on the unrelated item above. `--ran` reconciliation: 46 run, 0 unrun.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before each push: VERDICT clean exit 0 (last against origin/main dc53d4a6, after merging main with #35288 in).
- Full dogfood not owed: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
